skill.displayName: AI Lingerie Models – Generate Realistic Lingerie Visuals Online – API-powered
skill.summary: AI lingerie models — transform a person photo into a bikini model image or video

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-lingerie-models-openapi-skill.
- Transform a person's photo into a lingerie or bikini model image or video using WeShop OpenAPI.
- Requires HTTPS access and a WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable.
- Supports uploading images, custom text descriptions, output type selection (image or video), and batch generation.
- Provides detailed instructions for API key security and usage.
